Title: Retirement: Azure Synapse Runtime for Apache Spark 3.3

Body.Content:
End of Support for Azure Synapse Runtime for Apache Spark 3.3 was announced on July 12th, 2024. We recommend that you upgrade your Apache Spark 3.3-based workloads to Azure Synapse Runtime for Apache Spark 3.4 - Azure Synapse Analytics | Microsoft Learn.  Azure Synapse runtime for Apache Spark 3.3 will be retired and disabled March 2025.

Learn more.
